cards.name: Shove
cards.text: Push one adjacent enemy one hex. The actor does not follow.

cards.name: Dash
cards.text: Move one friendly piece to an adjacent empty hex.

cards.name: Brace
cards.text: Give one friendly piece Brace until it cancels a displacement or the round ends.

cards.name: Cull
cards.text: Trash exactly two cards. Cull can be one of them.

cards.name: Drive
cards.text: Push one adjacent enemy one hex, then follow into its old hex.

cards.name: Breaker
cards.text: Remove Brace from one adjacent enemy, then push it one hex.

cards.name: Press
cards.text: Push one adjacent enemy one hex. If you displaced it earlier this round, push it one additional hex. The actor does not follow.

cards.name: Pull
cards.text: Pull an enemy exactly two hexes away one hex toward the actor.

cards.name: Vault
cards.text: Jump one friendly piece over one adjacent piece into the empty hex beyond it.

cards.name: Sweep
cards.text: Move one adjacent enemy 120 degrees clockwise or counterclockwise around the actor. The actor does not follow.

cards.name: Relay
cards.text: Swap the positions of your two pieces at any distance. Use Relay once per round.

cards.name: Block
cards.text: Place a Block next to one friendly piece until round cleanup.

cards.name: Pin
cards.text: Cancel one enemy's next baseline move attempt. Pin also enables Corner.

cards.name: Corner
cards.text: Push one adjacent enemy one hex. If it was Pinned, or ends next to your Block, push it one additional hex. The actor does not follow.
